protocolRegistry.targetState: Elevated self-reported tension or arousal that the person has noticed themselves.
protocolRegistry.intendedPopulation: One adult using MindAnchor for personal, non-clinical self-experimentation.
exclusions: Not established for any respiratory or cardiovascular condition.
Not for anyone whose clinician has advised against breathing exercises.

evidenceSources.title: Brief structured respiration practices enhance mood and reduce physiological arousal
evidenceSources.citation: Balban MY, Neri E, Kogon MM, Weed L, Nouriani B, Jo B, Holl G, Zeitzer JM, Spiegel D, & Huberman AD (2023). Cell Reports Medicine 4(1):100895.

evidenceSources.title: Slow breathing reduces chemoreflex response to hypoxia and hypercapnia, and increases baroreflex sensitivity
evidenceSources.citation: Bernardi L, Gabutti A, Porta C, & Spicuzza L (2001). J. Hypertens. 19(12):2221-2229.

protocolRegistry.mechanism: Bernardi et al. measured slow breathing at six breaths a minute and found it depressed chemoreflex responses and increased baroreflex sensitivity, which is the parasympathetic route the long exhale is thought to take. The double inhale is what makes the breath a sigh rather than an ordinary slow breath. Neither paper isolated which component carries the effect.
protocolRegistry.expectedOutcome: A hypothesis, not a finding: higher same-day self-reported mood, relative to this person's own recent days. Balban et al. attribute the largest positive-affect gain and the largest resting-respiratory-rate drop to this arm; state anxiety moved equally across all of their breathing arms, so this protocol claims nothing distinctive there.
eligibilityRules: The person chose to start it.
No exclusion listed in this protocol applies to them.
contraindicationRules: Stop if breathing becomes uncomfortable or the person feels lightheaded.
Do not run while driving or operating machinery.
Do not run during physical exertion.

steps.instruction: Breathe in through the nose until the lungs are full.
Take a second, shorter sip of air through the nose on top of the first.
Let the breath out slowly through the mouth until it runs out, then begin the cycle again until the five minutes are up.

protocolRegistry.successInterpretation: Compared only against this person's own recent days. No clinical threshold, cut-off, or score is applied, and no result is evidence of a treatment effect.
protocolRegistry.userFacingExplanation: A five-minute breathing practice. A randomised trial with healthy adults compared a version of it against other breathing patterns; MindAnchor's cycle is shorter than the one that trial used. MindAnchor records this as a research protocol. It is not treatment, and it makes no promise about how you will feel.

transformations.output: A block-resampled threshold, expected episode rate, seed, and configuration.
transformations.description: Scores each historical day against its own weekday/weekend stratum, then calibrates thresholds with block resampling against an engineering false-observation budget rather than clinical accuracy.

transformations.input: A passive observation state with its domain evidence and data status.
transformations.description: Renders fixed templates that describe recorded signals and data limitations without diagnosis, prediction, or intervention language.

transformations.input: Point-in-time eligible daily passive-feature revisions within one baseline segment.
transformations.output: Frozen-reference and trailing-candidate feature centres, scales, and sample counts.
transformations.description: Builds a personal baseline from median/MAD statistics, with a declared IQR fallback for zero MAD and eligibility floors for total, weekday, weekend, and stratum data. Canonical point-in-time revisions freeze at the first eligible ingestion cutoff. The frozen reference and trailing candidate use the same pooling decision for a like-for-like population comparison.

transformations.input: Journal entries, structural context, morning measures, ledger events, study phases.
transformations.output: A canonically sorted, content-hashed research export document.
transformations.description: Sorts every list into a stable order and hashes the content, so two exports of the same data agree byte for byte regardless of when or where they were taken.

transformations.input: One Journal entry, as the person wrote it.
transformations.output: Structural FACT rows: entry kind, local date, word count, user-authored title.
transformations.description: Derives structural metadata only. It reads no meaning from the body text: no sentiment, no inferred emotion, no clinical interpretation.

missingDataStatement: Nothing is imputed, interpolated, carried forward, or filled in. Every absence in the reported window is listed with a reason. The window is stated in this file, in the exporting device’s local dates: it ends on the device’s export date — never after it, because a day that has not happened cannot be missing — and reaches back about ten years. When no record could be an observation, the window is absent and no absence is reported, which is not the same as having missed nothing. Records dated outside the window are excluded from it and from the reasons given inside it, and still appear in the data.

dataDictionary.statement: Every variable a MindAnchor research export can contain. Frozen: a change to this document requires a new version, and the old version stays readable forever.
dataDictionary.missingDataStatement: Nothing is imputed, interpolated, carried forward, or filled in. Every absence in the reported window is listed with a reason. The window is stated in this file, in the exporting device’s local dates: it ends on the device’s export date — never after it, because a day that has not happened cannot be missing — and reaches back about ten years. When no record could be an observation, the window is absent and no absence is reported, which is not the same as having missed nothing. Records dated outside the window are excluded from it and from the reasons given inside it, and still appear in the data.

variables.name: id
variables.description: Stable identifier for this entry.

variables.name: createdAt
variables.description: When the entry was first saved.

variables.name: updatedAt
variables.description: When the entry was last written.

variables.name: localDate
variables.description: The local calendar date the entry belongs to. The join key for daily analysis.

variables.name: title
variables.description: The title the person typed. Empty if they typed none.

variables.name: body
variables.description: The entry in the person's own words, stored exactly as written. Nothing reads meaning from it.

variables.name: kind
variables.description: Which writing surface produced the entry.

variables.name: sourceDeviceId
variables.description: The phone that recorded the entry.

variables.name: deletedAt
variables.description: When the person removed the entry, or null. The row is kept; content is never destroyed.

variables.name: id
variables.description: Stable identifier for this context row.

variables.name: entryId
variables.description: The Journal entry this was derived from.

variables.name: recordType
variables.description: FACT for a structural observation. INFERENCE exists in the schema but this build derives none.

variables.name: key
variables.description: Which structural fact this row holds.

variables.name: value
variables.description: The fact's value, as text.

variables.name: sourceStart
variables.description: Start offset in the entry body, or null.

variables.name: sourceEnd
variables.description: End offset in the entry body, or null.

variables.name: confidence
variables.description: Always 1.0 in this build: a structural count is not a guess.

variables.name: extractorVersion
variables.description: The transformation version that produced the row.

variables.name: createdAt
variables.description: When the row was derived.

variables.name: id
variables.description: Stable identifier for this measure.

variables.name: localDate
variables.description: The local calendar date the measure covers. One measure per date.

variables.name: createdAt
variables.description: When the measure was first saved.

variables.name: updatedAt
variables.description: When the measure was last edited.

variables.name: mood
variables.description: Self-rated 1 to 5, where 1 is "Low" and 5 is "High". A personal research measure. No total, threshold, or cut-off is computed from it anywhere.

variables.name: anxiety
variables.description: Self-rated 1 to 5, where 1 is "Calm" and 5 is "Tense". A personal research measure. No total, threshold, or cut-off is computed from it anywhere.

variables.name: angerUrge
variables.description: Self-rated 1 to 5, where 1 is "Steady" and 5 is "Reactive". A personal research measure. No total, threshold, or cut-off is computed from it anywhere.

variables.name: energyFunction
variables.description: Self-rated 1 to 5, where 1 is "Depleted" and 5 is "Energized". A personal research measure. No total, threshold, or cut-off is computed from it anywhere.

variables.name: sleepQuality
variables.description: Self-rated 1 to 5, where 1 is "Poor" and 5 is "Great". A personal research measure. No total, threshold, or cut-off is computed from it anywhere.

variables.name: instrumentVersion
variables.description: The version of the five-item measure that was answered.

variables.name: sourceDeviceId
variables.description: The phone that recorded the measure.

variables.name: id
variables.description: The event's own hash. The row is content-addressed.

variables.name: sequence
variables.description: Position in the chain, 1-based and contiguous.

variables.name: kind
variables.description: What the event records. Its origin depends on event kind: chosen by the person for a self-reported event and assigned by MindAnchor for a provenance event.

variables.name: occurredAt
variables.description: When the recorded thing happened. Its origin depends on event kind: supplied by the person for a self-reported event and assigned by MindAnchor for a provenance event.

variables.name: recordedAt
variables.description: When the row was written. Never rewritten.

variables.name: localDate
variables.description: The local calendar date of occurredAt. The join key for daily analysis.

variables.name: studyPhaseId
variables.description: The study phase in effect when the row was written.

variables.name: sourceDeviceId
variables.description: The phone that wrote the row.

variables.name: note
variables.description: Text whose origin depends on event kind: the person's exact words for a self-reported event, and an empty value assigned by MindAnchor for a provenance event. Never interpreted.

variables.name: payloadJson
variables.description: Structured detail for an event MindAnchor wrote about itself. "{}" for a self-reported one.

variables.name: previousEventHash
variables.description: The preceding event's hash. Empty at sequence 1.

variables.name: eventHash
variables.description: This event's hash, over its own contents plus the previous hash.

variables.name: id
variables.description: The phase's own hash over its ordinal, start and version vector.

variables.name: ordinal
variables.description: Position in the sequence of phases, 0-based.

variables.name: startedAt
variables.description: When the phase opened. A phase has no end: it runs until the next one starts.

variables.name: reason
variables.description: Which part of the version vector changed to open this phase.

variables.name: appVersionCode
variables.description: The app build in effect during the phase.

variables.name: appVersionName
variables.description: The app version name in effect during the phase.

variables.name: protocolCatalogSha256
variables.description: Content hash of the evidence protocol catalogue in effect.

variables.name: ruleSetVersion
variables.description: The decision-rule set in effect. This build ships none.

variables.name: modelSetVersion
variables.description: The model set in effect. This build ships none.

variables.name: transformationSetVersion
variables.description: Content hash of the transformation registry in effect.

variables.name: missingDataPolicyVersion
variables.description: The missing-data policy in effect.

variables.name: instrumentVersion
variables.description: The morning-measure instrument in effect.

variables.name: dictionaryVersion
variables.description: The data dictionary in effect.

variables.name: sourceDeviceId
variables.description: The phone the phase opened on.

variables.name: localDate
variables.description: The local calendar date the value is absent for.

variables.name: variable
variables.description: Which variable is absent.

variables.name: reason
variables.description: Why it is absent. Nothing is filled in to replace it.
